offering_description.value: Franchisor of local staffing offices that place temporary and direct-hire blue-collar workers with businesses. Franchisees pay royalties and fees, while the company supplies the brand, systems and training.

primary_services.value: temporary staffing; direct-hire placement; payroll services for temporary workers

customer_segment.value: B2B: businesses needing light industrial, manufacturing, warehouse and hospitality labor

end_markets.value: light industrial; manufacturing; warehousing and logistics; construction; hospitality

revenue_model.value: licensing or royalties: franchise royalties on staffing revenue earned by franchisee offices; other: initial franchise fees and other brand and system fees paid by franchisees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: places temporary and direct-hire workers with business customers, sold through franchisee offices; other: franchisor collecting royalties from independently owned staffing offices

geography_served.value: US national: franchised staffing offices across many US states

specialization.value: niche specialist: blue-collar and light industrial staffing franchises

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: independently owned franchisee staffing offices

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: employment and wage-and-hour rules from the US Department of Labor and state agencies, and franchise sales rules from the FTC

notes: Description is based on general knowledge of the franchise model; the current office count and brand lineup may have changed.
